description: This file defines the main page component for a note-taking app frontend. It manages state for notes, filters, selection, and modal dialogs, and composes various UI components such as headers, sidebars, notes list, note details, and note editors. It also interacts with an external API to load, create, update, and delete notes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the API and updates the state, handling errors and loading state.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note via the API and updates the notes state.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Updates the currently selected note via the API and updates the notes state.

methods.name: deleteSelected
methods.description: Deletes the selected note via the API and updates the notes state.

methods.name: togglePinned
methods.description: Toggles the pinned status of the selected note.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the selected note.
